SEC 03Notes & Commercial Terms
GOVERNANCE
Document NotesOperational narrative
  • Scope: materials, equipment and supplies for Phase 2 of the Northgate Foods factory (production hall & utilities), awarded under contract NGF/CON/2026/P2-014.
  • Items 1–3 and 7–10 were delivered in full on the dates shown on the signed delivery notes; grouped items were delivered per section.
  • Installation charges apply only where an installation rate is stated per item. All other items are supply-only.
  • Tax invoice: VAT is charged at 7.5%. WHT at 5% is deducted at source by the client; a valid WHT credit note must be returned within 30 days.
Terms & ConditionsClauses T-01 – T-08
T-01Payment: Net 30 days from invoice date. Payment is by electronic transfer to the accounts shown; quote the invoice number as reference.
T-02Late payment: overdue balances attract interest at 1.5% per month on the outstanding amount after the due date.
T-03Retention of title: goods remain the property of the issuer until paid for in full.
T-04Inspection: any shortage, damage or non-conformity must be reported in writing within 7 days of delivery; claims after this period may not be accepted.
T-05Warranty: manufacturer warranties apply as stated per item; workmanship on installed items is warranted for 12 months.
T-06Returns: special-order and cut-to-length items (e.g. cables, conduit) are non-returnable.
T-07Disputes: unresolved disputes are referred to arbitration in Lagos under the Arbitration and Mediation Act.
T-08Governing law: the laws of the Federal Republic of Nigeria.

SEC 03Notes & Commercial Terms
GOVERNANCE
Document NotesOperational narrative
  • Procurement for: Northgate Foods factory — Phase 2 (contract NGF/CON/2026/P2-014), as per approved material schedule.
  • Prices are unit costs agreed under the supplier’s quotation ref. MIW/Q/2026/883 dated 22/10/2026.
  • Partial deliveries are acceptable only with prior written approval; each delivery must carry a delivery note quoting this PO number.
  • Documentation: mill test certificates (items 2–3), type-test reports (items 5–6) and warranty cards (items 7–9, 16–18) must accompany the goods.
Terms & ConditionsClauses T-01 – T-08
T-01Supplier payment terms: payment within 30 days upon receipt of delivery and a verified tax invoice quoting this PO number.
T-02Delivery: by 20/11/2026 to the site address shown; early or late delivery requires 48-hour prior notice.
T-03Quality & inspection: goods are subject to inspection on arrival. Non-conforming goods will be rejected at the supplier’s cost and replaced within 7 days.
T-04Penalties: late delivery attracts 0.5% of the line value per day, capped at 10% of the order value.
T-05Packing & marking: goods must be packed to withstand road transit and marked with PO number, item number and weight.
T-06Warranty: manufacturer warranty plus a 12-month supplier warranty against defects in materials and workmanship.
T-07Changes: amendments to this order are valid only if issued in writing by the purchasing officer.
T-08Confidentiality: pricing and project details are confidential to the parties.
